_说明.Documentation: Full translation extracts names and updates a brief rolling synopsis per window. With synopsis in the input, return glossary_used and synopsis; otherwise return only glossary_used. Synopsis is saved to a file and reused and updated when translation continues.

system_prompt: Analyze manga text and extract consistent translations of proper names. Return JSON only. Write translations and the synopsis in English.
user_prompt_prefix: Input text contains page-ordered bubble text; glossary contains authoritative existing translations. Return only new proper names and their fixed translations in glossary_used. Do not repeat or change existing entries or extract ordinary words. Only if the input contains synopsis, also return an updated synopsis string. This synopsis is exclusive to full translation. Use multiple paragraphs as needed, up to 6000 characters. Preserve key events, relationships, motives and unresolved threads; compress older details when approaching the limit. Compress the previous synopsis together with explicit new facts, retaining key events and established relationships. Do not list pages, repeatedly append old events, or infer speakers, gender, bubble reading order or unstated plot details. Preserve the previous synopsis when there is no new plot information.
